
```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', include=knitr::is_html_output()}
ch_file   <- knitr::current_input()

# Strip any path prefix, keep only the base filename
ch_base   <- basename(ch_file)

# Handle edge case where current_input returns _main.Rmd during bookdown build
if (ch_base == "_main.Rmd" || nchar(ch_base) == 0) {
  invisible(NULL)
} else {
  docx_name <- gsub("\\.Rmd$", ".docx", ch_base)
  docx_path <- paste0("chapter_downloads/", docx_name)
  
  cat(sprintf(
    '<a href="%s" download class="btn-download">⬇ Download this chapter (.docx)</a>\n\n',
    docx_path
  ))
}
```
